packageRules.description: Sentinel Aura: the submodule follows the release tags of Aura, which .gitmodules names as its branch, one pull request for each release; the aura-bump skill completes it with the tutorials that the release changes (docs/authoring.md, Move to a New Version of Aura)

A version of a package, an image, or an action is proposed once it is seven days old, as in Aura, so that a release that its registry withdraws or that turns out compromised in its first days never reaches the tooling; the submodule follows Aura's release tags at once, whose Git tags carry no release time
Playwright: the npm package and the image of the Containerfile move together, so that the browsers of the image are the ones that Playwright expects
Every other dependency of the tooling, weekly, in one pull request; an update that leaves the screens unchanged needs no new video (docs/authoring.md, Update the Tools)
The Renovate image of the validation workflow
